prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development cover (ADC) reinsurance contract purchase
prior_year_events.impact_description: Purchased December 2018 providing whole account protection for 2018 and prior years; favourable development in claims estimates covered by the contract (reduction GBP 64.8m) was offset by a reduction in the reinsurance recoverable under the ADC contract (GBP 34.7m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss portfolio transfer of European employers' liability/general liability portfolio
prior_year_events.impact_description: During 2018 the Syndicate purchased reinsurance by means of a loss portfolio transfer of its European (predominantly Irish) employers' liability/general liability portfolio.

named_events.loss_description: Notably impacted current accident year large losses in Marine and Aviation

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 3,458.9m. During 2019 there was an adverse prior-year movement on gross claims of GBP 51.4m (a 1.49% strengthening of reserves). The movement reflects a mix of adverse prior-year development (notably attritional deterioration in Marine & Aviation prior accident years and current large losses such as the Ethiopian Airlines/Boeing accident) together with interactions from reinsurance (including the ADC purchased in December 2018 which produced reductions in best estimate reserves and corresponding reductions in reinsurance recoverables).
raw_causal_phrases: attritional deterioration within the prior accident year (within War, Cargo, Liability and Hull classes)
The benefit of this reduction (GBP 64.8m) in the best estimate reserves was offset by a reduction in the reinsurance recoverable under the ADC contract (GBP 34.7m).
reinsurance recoveries were recognised in 2018 for the element of this margin that would be recoverable under the contract.
In 2019, there has been favourable development in the claims estimates that are covered by the contract.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure taken from Note 11(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (gross = 51.4). The ADC and reinsurer recoverable interactions are described in narrative and partially quantified (64.8 reduction in best estimate, 34.7 reduction in reinsurance recoverable) which complicate net vs gross interpretation; the reported gross prior-year movement is nonetheless the 51.4 figure from the movement table. Some LOB-specific PYD amounts are not quantified in the report; lob_movements use directions inferred from SBU commentary. Claims development triangle is present and was used for cross-checking.
